### Events

| Name              | Payload     | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| ----------------- | ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `refresh`         | `undefined` | User clicked the Refresh item in the header's overflow Actions menu. Payload: `{ widgetId, title }`. Handlers may call the second arg's `preventDefault()` to suppress the built-in default (event-bus emit on `cn:page:refresh`).          |
| `request-feature` | `undefined` | User clicked the Request a feature item in the header's overflow Actions menu. Payload: `{ widgetId, title }`. Handlers may call the second arg's `preventDefault()` to suppress the built-in default (auto-opening CnSuggestFeatureModal). |
